name: Orbit AI - Phase 1 - Portal abandonment follow-up (new, not brief-W-numbered)

nodes.name: Every 6 hours
nodes.notes: 06's audit-gap list: 'portal abandonment: targeted follow-up on incomplete e-sign.' 48h-since-viewed (below) is this pass's own judgment call for 'abandoned,' not brief-specified - long enough that a same-day signer isn't nagged, short enough that the lead is still warm.

nodes.name: Fetch Opportunities in proposal stage
nodes.notes: Scoped to stage='DemoCompleted' - the funnel stage between demo and Won/Lost where a proposal would plausibly have been sent, since there's no dedicated 'Proposal Sent' stage value confirmed anywhere in this repo. Filters further client-side (next node) for the real signal: proposalViewedAt actually set.

nodes.name: Draft abandonment follow-up

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-5', max_tokens: 512, system: [{ type: 'text', text: 'You draft short, low-pressure messages for a lead who opened a sales proposal but never signed. One or two sentences, offer to answer questions, no pressure tactics. DRAFT ONLY for a rep to review before sending - never implies it has been sent.', cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } }], messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Company: ' + $json.companyName + '\nProposal viewed: ' + $json.proposalViewedAt + '\nDraft a gentle nudge.' }] }) }}

nodes.notes: Draft only - a portal-abandonment nudge is an external send, human approves/sends, same rule as every other outreach-draft workflow in this repo.

nodes.name: Write follow-up state
nodes.notes: Single-shot, not a repeating cadence like W2.2/W2.3 - abandonmentFollowupSentAt being set at all is what excludes this Opportunity from future runs of 'Filter abandoned' above, regardless of whether the rep actually sends the draft.

nodes.name: Alert: abandonment follow-up ready

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'info', source: 'portal-abandonment-followup', message: $('Filter abandoned').item.json.companyName + ' viewed the proposal but never signed - follow-up draft ready.', linkUrl: ($env.TWENTY_CRM_BASE_URL || '') + '/objects/opportunity/' + $('Filter abandoned').item.json.id }) }}

nodes.notes: Routes to #portal-conversion (alertRouting.ts matches 'portal' in the source string).
